title.english: What Came Back in the Box

pairs.target: nài lěi huílái shí , tǎ wéi méiyǒu rènchū tā de jiǎobù .
pairs.english: When Nerai returned, Tavi did not recognize her footsteps.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾回来时，塔维没有认出她的脚步。

pairs.target: nàtiān tā zài běi gōngfáng tì mǐlā yā túzhǐ , ménwài xiān chuánlái tuō xiāngzǐ de shēngyīn , jiēzhe yǒurén jiào jiè guò .
pairs.english: That day he was weighting drawings for Mira in the north workshop when a box scraped outside the door, followed by someone asking to pass.
pairs.hanzi: 那天他在北工房替米拉压图纸，门外先传来拖箱子的声音，接着有人叫借过。

pairs.target: tā chuān le yìshuāng sōng xié , pījiān juàn zài bìwān lǐ , tóufa bèi màozi yābiǎn , yìbiān jiānbǎng gāo yìbiān dī .
pairs.english: She wore loose shoes, her cape rolled in the crook of her arm, her hair flattened by her hat, one shoulder higher than the other.
pairs.hanzi: 她穿了一双松鞋，披肩卷在臂弯里，头发被帽子压扁，一边肩膀高一边低。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn qǐlái tài kuài , bǎ yā zhǐ de mùkuài pèngdào dìshàng .
pairs.english: Tavi stood too quickly and knocked a paperweight block to the floor.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站起来太快，把压纸的木块碰到地上。

pairs.target: nài lěi kàn le kàn tā , yòu kàn le kàn mùkuài , shuō tā cái zǒu èrshísì tiān , búzhìyú lián mén dōu búhuì jìn le .
pairs.english: Nerai looked at him, then the block, and said she had only been gone twenty-four days: surely she hadn't forgotten how to enter a door.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看了看他，又看了看木块，说她才走二十四天，不至于连门都不会进了。

pairs.target: tā jiē zhù xiāngzǐ lìngyìduān , wèn tā shìbushì shāng le jiǎo .
pairs.english: He took the box's other end and asked whether she had hurt her feet.
pairs.hanzi: 他接住箱子另一端，问她是不是伤了脚。

pairs.target: tā shuō méi shāng , shì chuān yìng xuē zǒu jiǔ le , huílái dìyījiàn shì jiùshì huànxié .
pairs.english: She said no: after so much walking in stiff boots, changing shoes had been her first act on returning.
pairs.hanzi: 她说没伤，是穿硬靴走久了，回来第一件事就是换鞋。

pairs.target: hè shīfu hái zài huòzhàn jiāo dōngxī , tā xiān bǎ xuégōng jiè de zhè jǐjiàn sòng huílái , zài qù zhǎo chī de .
pairs.english: Master He was still handing things in at the freight station. She would return these academy loans first, then find food.
pairs.hanzi: 贺师傅还在货站交东西，她先把学宫借的这几件送回来，再去找吃的。

pairs.target: xiāngdǐ cèng guò zhuō yán , liúxià yìtiáo huī yìn .
pairs.english: The box bottom scraped the table edge, leaving a gray streak.
pairs.hanzi: 箱底蹭过桌沿，留下一条灰印。

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu zhòuméi , fǎnér shēnshǒu mōlemō nà yìnzǐ , wèn shì hébiān de ní ma .
pairs.english: Rather than frown, Mira touched the streak and asked if it was river mud.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没有皱眉，反而伸手摸了摸那印子，问是河边的泥吗。

pairs.target: " yě yǒu chéngménkǒu de . " nài lěi shuō , " bié bǎ yílùshang cǎi de dōngxī dōu suàn gěi běi chà . "
pairs.english: “Some from the city gate too,” Nerai said. “Don't charge Northfork with everything we stepped in along the way.”
pairs.hanzi: “也有城门口的。”奈蕾说，“别把一路上踩的东西都算给北汊。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le , zhèshí cái zhēn juéde tā huílái le .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed. Only then did it truly feel as though she was back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了，这时才真觉得她回来了。

pairs.target: tā qù ná shuǐ , huílái shí , nài lěi yǐjīng zuòxià , bǎ xié wǎngqián tī sōng yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: He fetched water. When he returned, Nerai had sat down and loosened her shoes with a forward kick.
pairs.hanzi: 他去拿水，回来时，奈蕾已经坐下，把鞋往前踢松一点。

alignment.english: loosened her shoes with a forward kick

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu mǎshàng kāixiāng , xiān bǎ yíkuài bǐng chī wán , wèn mǐlā nà zuò qiáo zhǎn dé zěnyàng .
pairs.english: She did not open the box immediately; first she ate a flatbread and asked how Mira's bridge exhibition had gone.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有马上开箱，先把一块饼吃完，问米拉那座桥展得怎样。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuōchū le gè xīn wèntí , biérén wèn héng zhe tuī zěnmebàn .
pairs.english: Mira said a new question had come up: someone asked about a push from the side.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说出了个新问题，别人问横着推怎么办。

alignment.english: about a push from the side

pairs.target: nài lěi yào tā huà gěi zìjǐ kàn , tīng wán méiyǒu gěi dáàn , zhī shuō huílái de zhènghǎo , kěyǐ qù fān tā jièchū de nà běn jiù qiáo cè , wéi lǎoshī zhīdào fàng nǎér .
pairs.english: Nerai asked her to draw it. After listening she offered no answer, only said her return was timely: Mira could consult the old bridge book she had lent out; Instructor Vey knew where it was.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾要她画给自己看，听完没有给答案，只说回来得正好，可以去翻她借出的那本旧桥册，维老师知道放哪儿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù shuō zìjǐ bǎ zhǐ sòngjìnqù le .
pairs.english: Tavi could not help saying he had got the paper through.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忍不住说自己把纸送进去了。

pairs.target: nài lěi tíngxià hēshuǐ , wèn shénme zhǐ , tā cái xiǎngqǐ tā méi kànjiàn nà táng kè .
pairs.english: Nerai paused drinking and asked what paper; only then did he remember she hadn't seen that lesson.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾停下喝水，问什么纸，他才想起她没看见那堂课。

pairs.target: tā cóngtóu jiǎng , lián xiùzǐ yě jiǎng le .
pairs.english: He told it from the beginning, including the sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 他从头讲，连袖子也讲了。

pairs.target: tā tīngdào zhǐ zuìhòu hú zài liǎnshàng , xiào dé hāi le yíxià , jiào tā bǎ bēizi ná yuǎn .
pairs.english: When she heard how the paper finally stuck to his face, she laughed into a cough and told him to move the cup away.
pairs.hanzi: 她听到纸最后糊在脸上，笑得咳了一下，叫他把杯子拿远。

pairs.target: zhídào chī wán , tā cái xiānkāi xiāng gài .
pairs.english: Only after eating did she lift the lid.
pairs.hanzi: 直到吃完，她才掀开箱盖。

pairs.target: liǎngtào zhǐshìqì hái zài bùtào lǐ , wàicéng yǒu shuǐ hén , lǐmiàn shì gān de .
pairs.english: Both indicators were still in their cloth sleeves. There were water marks on the outside, but inside they were dry.
pairs.hanzi: 两套指示器还在布套里，外层有水痕，里面是干的。

pairs.target: nà zhāng xiě dà le de jìlùzhǐ duō le jǐhángzì , jiǎoluò yā zhe yígè qīngchǔ de zhǐyìn .
pairs.english: The record sheet with enlarged handwriting now had several extra lines and a clear fingerprint in one corner.
pairs.hanzi: 那张写大了的记录纸多了几行字，角落压着一个清楚的指印。

pairs.target: tā shuō xiàyǔ nàtiān hè shīfu ná tā héduì , mà zìjǐ zǎonián xiězì xiàng mǎyǐ , qíngtiān hái néng rèn , shī le quánhuì pá .
pairs.english: She said Master He had used it for checking on the rainy day, cursing his younger self's ant-like handwriting: readable in sunshine, but in the wet it all crawled away.
pairs.hanzi: 她说下雨那天贺师傅拿它核对，骂自己早年写字像蚂蚁，晴天还能认，湿了全会爬。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi mō zhe bùtào biān , méiyǒu qù pèng xì zhēn .
pairs.english: Tavi touched the sleeve's edge, leaving the fine pointer alone.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摸着布套边，没有去碰细针。

pairs.target: yuánlái dōngxī sòngchūqù , zài huílái , zhēnde huì dài zhe biérén yòng guò de yàngzi .
pairs.english: Things sent out and brought back really did carry the marks of someone else's use.
pairs.hanzi: 原来东西送出去，再回来，真的会带着别人用过的样子。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng wèn zìjǐ zuò dé suànbusuàn hǎo , yòu juéde nà jǐháng tiānshàngqù de zì yǐjīng huídá le yíbàn .
pairs.english: He wanted to ask if his work had been good, but felt the added lines had already half answered.
pairs.hanzi: 他想问自己做得算不算好，又觉得那几行添上去的字已经回答了一半。

pairs.target: nài lěi náchū lìng yígè xiǎobāo . lǐmiàn shì liǎngzhī mó jiù de mùxiē , chángduǎn bùtóng , biānjiǎo xiàng bèi xǔduō shǒumō yuán le .
pairs.english: Nerai took out another packet containing two worn wooden wedges of different lengths, their edges rounded as though by many hands.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾拿出另一个小包。里面是两只磨旧的木楔，长短不同，边角像被许多手摸圆了。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhè shì dàilù de yǎ lì gěi de , huàn guò xīn de yíduì , jiù de liúgěi tāmen zuò yàng .
pairs.english: She said their guide Yali had given them the old pair after replacing them with new ones, as samples.
pairs.hanzi: 她说这是带路的雅栗给的，换过新的一对，旧的留给他们做样。

pairs.target: yǎ lì jiāzhù zài héwān gāodì , xiūchuán péng shì tā shūfù de .
pairs.english: Yali lived on high ground by the river bend; the boat shed belonged to her uncle.
pairs.hanzi: 雅栗家住在河湾高地，修船棚是她叔父的。

pairs.target: qù kàn qiáo de dìyītiān , hè shīfu zhào tú wǎng jiù shātān zǒu , tā bù gēn , shuō cóng shàngyóu guò .
pairs.english: On the first day of bridge inspection, Master He headed toward the old sandbar according to the map. She refused to follow and said to cross upstream.
pairs.hanzi: 去看桥的第一天，贺师傅照图往旧沙滩走，她不跟，说从上游过。

pairs.target: ràolù duō le bàngè shíchén , dào le gāochù cái kànjiàn , zhōngjiān xīn chōng chūlái de shuǐgōu bǐ rén zài ànbiān kànzhe shēn dé duō .
pairs.english: The detour took an extra hour. Only from higher ground could they see how much deeper the new channel was than it had looked from the bank.
pairs.hanzi: 绕路多了半个时辰，到了高处才看见，中间新冲出来的水沟比人在岸边看着深得多。

pairs.target: mǐlā nábǐ bǎ nà dào shuǐgōu huà zài fèizhǐ shàng .
pairs.english: Mira sketched the channel on scrap paper.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉拿笔把那道水沟画在废纸上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe liǎngzhī mùxiē , wèn tāmen nálái gànshénme .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at the wedges and asked what they were for.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着两只木楔，问它们拿来干什么。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō jià línshí tàbǎn , shuǐ zhǎng shí zhěngkuài bǎn kěyǐ shōuzǒu , bié liúzài hélǐ dǎng piāo mù .
pairs.english: Nerai said they supported temporary planks that could be removed whole when the water rose, rather than left in the river to block drifting timber.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说架临时踏板，水涨时整块板可以收走，别留在河里挡漂木。

pairs.target: búshì kào zhèliǎngkuài mùtou jiù néng guǎnzhù hé , tā dài huílái shì xiǎng gěi xuéshēng kànkàn , tāmen zěnyàng liúchū shōushí de yúdì .
pairs.english: Two bits of wood couldn't control a river; she had brought them to show students how people left room to take things away again.
pairs.hanzi: 不是靠这两块木头就能管住河，她带回来是想给学生看看，他们怎样留出收拾的余地。

pairs.target: tā zhǎnkāi néng gōngkāi de lù tú .
pairs.english: She unfolded the route map cleared for public viewing.
pairs.hanzi: 她展开能公开的路图。

pairs.target: dìsāngè yìzhí méi duì shàng de míngzì , zhōngyú xiě zài le dùkǒu páng , búshì yízuò lìngyǒuqí míng de qiáo .
pairs.english: The third unmatched name was finally written beside a ferry landing, not a separately named bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 第三个一直没对上的名字，终于写在了渡口旁，不是一座另有其名的桥。

pairs.target: dāngdìrén shuō qù nàlǐ guòhé , chuándào shānshàng , biàn yǒurén tì nàjùhuà tiān le yízuò qiáo .
pairs.english: Local people said they crossed there; by the time the words reached the mountains, someone had added a bridge to them.
pairs.hanzi: 当地人说去那里过河，传到山上，便有人替那句话添了一座桥。

pairs.target: " nàtiáo duǎnlù néng zǒu chē le ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Can carts use the short route now?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “那条短路能走车了？”塔维问。

pairs.target: nài lěi yáotóu , shuō rén néng zǒu de bùfen cháqīng le yìxiē , huòchē yào zhuǎnwān de dìfāng hái búgòu .
pairs.english: Nerai shook her head: some walking sections had been checked, but there was still not enough room for freight carts to turn.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾摇头，说人能走的部分查清了一些，货车要转弯的地方还不够。

alignment.english: some walking sections had been checked

pairs.target: tú shàng nà kuài xiàng kòngdì de dìfāng , qíshí shì jǐjiā shài wǎng de yuànzi .
pairs.english: What looked like empty ground on the map was really a yard several households used to dry nets.
pairs.hanzi: 图上那块像空地的地方，其实是几家晒网的院子。

pairs.target: yǒurén tíyì zhēng lái pūlù , yǎ lì wèn tāmen dōngtiān ná shénme bǔ lòuwǎng , nándào ràng dàjiā bǎ wǎng guà zài xīn lái de chēshàng .
pairs.english: Someone proposed requisitioning it for a road. Yali asked how they were meant to mend their leaking nets in winter: should they hang them on the incoming carts?
pairs.hanzi: 有人提议征来铺路，雅栗问他们冬天拿什么补漏网，难道让大家把网挂在新来的车上。

pairs.target: mǐlā dītóu kàn tú , yòu táitóu kàn tā .
pairs.english: Mira looked down at the map, then up at her.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉低头看图，又抬头看她。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō zuìhòu dài huílái de shì liǎnggè zuòfǎ de cǎoàn , yìtiáo ràoyuǎn yìdiǎn , yìtiáo yào lìng zhǎo shài wǎng de dìfāng , jiàqián hé shuí lái zuò dōuháiméi tándìng .
pairs.english: Nerai said they had brought back two draft options: a longer detour, or another place to dry nets. The price and who would do it were still unsettled.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说最后带回来的是两个做法的草案，一条绕远一点，一条要另找晒网的地方，价钱和谁来做都还没谈定。

pairs.target: tā bǎ nà kuài yuànzi miáo jìn túlǐ , què bùnéng tì zhù zài nàlǐ de rén diǎntóu .
pairs.english: She had drawn the yard onto the map, but could not consent for the people who lived there.
pairs.hanzi: 她把那块院子描进图里，却不能替住在那里的人点头。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ huò píngshàng mài yú de nǚrén .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the fish seller at the freight yard.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起货坪上卖鱼的女人。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō tā gē zhǎodào le , rújīn zài dùkǒu běibiān de suì shíjiē shōu yú , yǐjīng bǎ kǒuxìn jiāodào tān shàng .
pairs.english: Nerai said her brother had been found, buying fish at the gravel steps north of the landing; the message had already reached the stall.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说她哥找到了，如今在渡口北边的碎石阶收鱼，已经把口信交到摊上。

pairs.target: nà nǚrén wèn yú yǒuméiyǒu tài xián , hè shīfu bú zài , tā jiù tì tā shuō zhènghǎo .
pairs.english: The woman asked if the fish was too salty. Master He wasn't there, so Nerai answered for him: just right.
pairs.hanzi: 那女人问鱼有没有太咸，贺师傅不在，她就替他说正好。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒurén cuī hái dèngzǐ , nài lěi zhè cái fāxiànzìjǐ bǎ yì shuāngjiǎo dōu shēn dào le guò dào lǐ .
pairs.english: Someone outside the window asked for a stool back; only then did Nerai notice both her feet were stretched into the aisle.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有人催还凳子，奈蕾这才发现自己把一双脚都伸到了过道里。

pairs.target: tā ràng chūlù , kàn tǎ wéi bǎ dōngxī chóngxīn pái hǎo , wèn jiālǐ zuìjìn yǒuméiyǒu xìn .
pairs.english: She cleared the way, watched Tavi arrange the things again, and asked if there had been any news from home lately.
pairs.hanzi: 她让出路，看塔维把东西重新排好，问家里最近有没有信。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhōushīfu nà yíduàn jiǎng gěi tā tīng , shuō wǔtiān hòu huíqù .
pairs.english: He told her the part about Master Zhou, saying he would go back in five days.
pairs.hanzi: 他把周师傅那一段讲给她听，说五天后回去。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu cāi huí yùn de chē cóng nǎlǐ lái , zhī wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu bǎ wèntí dàishàng .
pairs.english: She did not guess where the returned cars came from, only asked whether he was taking his questions.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有猜回运的车从哪里来，只问他有没有把问题带上。

pairs.target: tā shuō dài , dàn zhèhuí bùxiǎng yí jìnmén jiù wèn .
pairs.english: He said yes, but he didn't want to start asking the moment he walked in this time.
pairs.hanzi: 他说带，但这回不想一进门就问。

pairs.target: nài lěi diǎntóu , bǎ zhuāng mùxiē de bùbāo tuī gěi tā , jiào tā míngtiān jiāogěi jiǎn lǎoshī , zhǐtiáo shàng xiě le lái chù .
pairs.english: Nerai nodded and pushed the wedge packet toward him, asking him to give it to Instructor Jian tomorrow; the note named its source.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾点头，把装木楔的布包推给他，叫他明天交给简老师，纸条上写了来处。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò lái , tīngjiàn tā yòu wèn shítáng jīnwǎn yǒuméiyǒu miàn .
pairs.english: As Tavi took it, she asked whether the dining hall had noodles tonight.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过来，听见她又问食堂今晚有没有面。

pairs.target: tā shuō míngmíng cái chī guò bǐng .
pairs.english: He said she had only just eaten bread.
pairs.hanzi: 他说明明才吃过饼。

pairs.target: tā shuō bǐng shì zài lùshang chī de nà dùn , bùnéng suàn huílái zhè yídùn .
pairs.english: She said bread belonged to the meal on the road and couldn't count as her homecoming meal.
pairs.hanzi: 她说饼是在路上吃的那顿，不能算回来这一顿。

pairs.target: tā zhèngyào zhēng , mǐlā yǐjīng shōuqǐ tú , shuō zǒu ba , biān zǒu biān suàn .
pairs.english: He was about to argue, but Mira had already put away the drawing. “Let's go. You can count as we walk.”
pairs.hanzi: 他正要争，米拉已经收起图，说走吧，边走边算。
